Apply every fix described below. Each section lists the file, the relevant lines, and exactly what to change.



 src/cloud/index.html

Fix 1 – runQuery (lines 427–453): Replace the inmemory .filter() with a real fetch call to POST /v1/databases/documents/query using apiCall. Build the request body from the query object (search, where, orderBy, limit). Return the parsed rows array from the response. Make runQuery async (return a Promise) and update all callers to await it.

Fix 2 – ensureMetrics (lines 402–425): Replace all Math.random() calls with a real fetch to GET /v1/analytics. Map the response fields (total_requests, avg_latency_ms, error_rate, etc.) to the m object. Keep the day guard so the call is only made once per day.

Fix 3 – seedIfEmpty (lines 455–483): Remove the hardcoded sample documents array, the fake log entries, and the fake notifications. Instead, call GET /v1/databases/documents/query (with no filter) to populate State.db.records, call GET /v1/audit to populate State.logs, and call GET /v1/sandbox to check sandbox status. Only seed saved queries if State.saved is empty (that part can remain local).



 src/cloud/http_server.zig

Fix 4 – /v1/analytics stub (lines 604–607): Replace the hardcoded {"total_requests":0,...} with real data. Add a RuntimeAnalytics struct (or pass a pointer to the runtime) to CloudServer. Populate total_requests, avg_latency_ms, and error_rate from actual counters maintained in the runtime or router.

Fix 5 – extractEmailFromBody (lines 631–646): Replace the indexOf string search with a call to json.parse. Parse body_buf as JSON, call getField("email"), and return asString(). This correctly handles whitespace, escaped characters, and key ordering.

Fix 51 – Request body buffer (lines 78–87): The 65536byte buf only buffers headers. The body is already read separately via content_length. However, content_length is parsed from headers that may be truncated if the header section itself exceeds 65536 bytes. Increase buf to 131072 bytes, or switch to a dynamic ArrayList that grows until \r\n\r\n is found.

Fix 52 – Request timeout (lines 41–56): Before calling server.accept(), set a read deadline on the accepted stream using std.posix.setsockopt with SO_RCVTIMEO (e.g., 30 seconds) so a slow client cannot block the thread forever.

Fix 53 – Thread pool (lines 48–54): Replace the unbounded std.Thread.spawn per connection with a fixedsize thread pool (e.g., 64 workers) and a bounded connection queue. Reject new connections with HTTP 503 when the queue is full.

Fix 54 – DELETE response 204 (line 516): Change const status_code: u16 = if (is_records_del) 200 else 200; to const status_code: u16 = if (is_records_del) 204 else 200;.

Fix 55 – API key deletion (lines 318–321): Implement real deletion: parse the key ID from the path, call ctx.server.reg.deleteApiKey(tenant_rec.tenant_id) (add this method to Registry that removes the hash and plainkey entries from KV), then return 204.

Fix 56 – /v1/analytics real data (lines 604–607): Same as Fix 4 above.

Fix 57 – /v1/audit real data (lines 609–612): Replace {"logs":[]} with a real audit log read. Store audit events in a pertenant KV key (e.g., audit:<tenant_id>) and return them here.

Fix 58 – /v1/admin/tenants real data (lines 614–617): Replace {"tenants":[]} with a real listing. Read the tenant_list key from the registry KV, split by comma, look up each tenant record, and serialize them.

Fix 59 – /v1/databases real listing (lines 428–431): Replace the hardcoded [{"name":"documents",...}] with a real listing. Add a listDatabases(tenant_id) method to the router/runtime that returns the actual database names for the tenant.

Fix 77 – extractEmailFromBody JSON parser (lines 631–646): Same as Fix 5 above.

Fix 78 – Webhook list concatenation (lines 588–591): The current code does e[1..e.len-1] assuming e is always [...]. Guard against nonarray format: if existing starts with [ and ends with ], strip the brackets; otherwise treat the existing value as a single element and wrap it. Use a proper JSON array builder.

Fix 101 – Sandbox start time (lines 346–355): Store the actual start timestamp in SandboxHandle (add a started_at_ns: i64 field). Set it in spawnTenantSandbox. Return it in the GET response instead of std.time.timestamp().



 src/runtime.zig

Fix 6 – cosineSimilarityKernel CPUonly naming (sandbox_runner.zig line 70): Rename cosineSimilarityKernel in src/cloud/sandbox_runner.zig to cosineSimilarityCPU and add a // CPU-only fallback comment. Add a dispatch wrapper that checks whether a real GPU context is available and calls the Futhark GPU path if so, otherwise falls back to the CPU implementation.

Fix 81 – RuntimeConfig.default ignores base_dir (lines 51–63): Remove _ = base_dir;. Use base_dir to construct all paths:
zig
.heap_path = try std.fs.path.join(allocator, &.{base_dir, "agdb.heap"}),
.wal_path  = try std.fs.path.join(allocator, &.{base_dir, "agdb.wal"}),
.snapshot_dir = try std.fs.path.join(allocator, &.{base_dir, "snapshots"}),

Since default cannot allocate, change its signature to accept an allocator, or change it to a builder pattern. Update all callers.



 src/rdma.zig

Fix 7 / Fix 12 – detectTransportMode misleading result (lines 75–80): Opening /dev/infiniband/rdma_cm only proves the file exists, not that ibverbs is functional. Change the function to also attempt ibv_get_device_list via dlopen("libibverbs.so.1"). Only return .hardware_verbs if the library loads and returns at least one device. Otherwise return .software_tcp. Add a // NOTE: software TCP simulation comment to the .software_tcp path.

Fix 11 – postRecv discards wr (lines 512–520): Replace _ = wr; with actual logic: copy wr.sge_list[0..wr.num_sge] into a perQP receive buffer ring. When a softwaremode receive completes (in pollCQ), copy the received bytes into the SGE buffers from the ring.



 src/tpm.c

Fix 8 / Fix 14 – tpm2_seal #else branch (lines 418–428): Replace the memcpy stub with a real software sealing implementation using AES256GCM (via a bundled or system crypto library). Derive a key from the PCR mask using HKDF over a softwaresimulated PCR state. Encrypt data and store the ciphertext + nonce + tag in sealed->data. Return an error if data_len exceeds the buffer.

Fix 9 / Fix 15 – tpm2_verify_pcr_policy #else branch (lines 451–457): Replace return 0; with a real comparison: call tpm2_read_pcr for each bit set in pcr_mask and compare the result against expected_pcrs[i]. Return -1 on mismatch.

Fix 10 / Fix 16 – tpm2_read_pcr #else branch (lines 412–416): Replace the zerofill stub with a software PCR simulation. Maintain a static array sim_pcr_banks[24][32] initialized to SHA256 of the index. Return the simulated value. This makes the nonLinux build testable.



 src/security.zig

Fix 17 – TPM2Interface.initialize (lines 534–536): Remove _ = self;. Call tpm2_init(&self.handle_storage, self.tcti.ptr) (add a handle_storage: tpm2_context_t field). On success set self.initialized = true. Return error.TPMInitFailed on failure.

Fix 18 – TPM2Interface.readPCR (lines 538–542): Remove _ = self; _ = pcr_index; return [_]u8{0} ** 32;. Call tpm2_read_pcr(&self.handle_storage, pcr_index, &digest). Copy digest.digest[0..32] into the return value.

Fix 19 – TPM2Interface.deinit (lines 530–532): Remove _ = self;. Call tpm2_deinit(&self.handle_storage) and set self.initialized = false.

Fix 64 – encrypt when !self.enabled (lines 143–148): Instead of silently returning a plaintext EncryptedRegion, either: (a) return error.EncryptionDisabled so callers are forced to handle the case, or (b) set a flag region.encrypted = false on the returned region and ensure all consumers check this flag before treating the data as confidential.

Fix 65 – check ignores op (lines 405–412): Remove _ = op;. Add a switch (op) that enforces different rules per operation type (e.g., .read only requires the pool to be attached; .write additionally requires the key to be nonexpired; .admin requires elevated privilege).



 src/cloud/wal_transport.zig

Fix 20 – TLS in connect (lines 134–166): After the plain TCP stream is established, check self.config.tls_enabled. If true, perform a TLS handshake using std.crypto.tls.Client (Zig 0.14 stdlib TLS). Store the TLS client in a new tls_client: ?std.crypto.tls.Client field and route all writeAll/readAll calls through it.

Fix 21 – receiveFrames discards record (lines 472–475): Replace _ = record; with try self.wal.appendRecord(record, payload[@sizeOf(wal_mod.WALRecord)..]) (or the appropriate WAL append API). This actually writes the received WAL record into the local WAL.

Fix 74 – sendBatch swallows errors (lines 222–229): Change the return type to !struct { sent: u32, failed: u32 }. Collect errors per item instead of catch continue. Return the counts so the caller can decide whether to retry failed items.

Fix 75 – acceptLoop race condition (lines 430–445): Replace the while (self.running.load(.acquire)) + server.accept() pattern with a nonblocking accept using epoll/kqueue. In deinit, close the server socket first, then set running = false. This prevents the accept from blocking after deinit closes the socket.



 src/snapshot.zig

Fix 22 / Fix 132 – restoreSnapshot heap lock (lines 395–403): Acquire self.heap.lock (or the appropriate heap write lock) before the @memcpy loop. Add a WAL record of type .root_update (or a new .snapshot_restore type) before writing pages, and commit it after the last page is written, so a crash midrestore can be detected and reapplied.

Fix 23 / Fix 130 – createSnapshot metadata not written (lines 305–312): After computing metadata.data_size (line 339), call try snapshot_file.writeAll(std.mem.asBytes(&metadata)); to persist the metadata struct to the file.

Fix 24 / Fix 131 – buildMerkleTree called after header write (lines 341–355): Move try self.buildMerkleTree(); to before snap_header.updateChecksum() and try snapshot_file.writeAll(std.mem.asBytes(&snap_header));. Copy self.merkle_tree[0].hash into snap_header.merkle_root before calling updateChecksum.

Fix 69 / Fix 134 – protectPages swallows mprotect error (lines 173–177): Change posix.mprotect(slice, posix.PROT.READ) catch {}; to try posix.mprotect(slice, posix.PROT.READ);. Only set self.protected[page_idx] = true after the call succeeds (move it inside a success branch).

Fix 86 / Fix 135 – listSnapshots useafterfree (lines 423–427): Change the function to return an owned copy: allocate a new slice with self.allocator.dupe(SnapshotInfo, self.snapshots.items), hold the lock only while copying, and document that the caller must free the returned slice.

Fix 136 – buildMerkleTree stale tree when len >= node_count (lines 480–483): The current code only reallocates when self.merkle_tree.len < node_count. When the heap shrinks, the old (larger) tree is reused with stale nodes. Change the condition to self.merkle_tree.len != node_count: free and reallocate whenever the size changes.



 src/gc.zig

Fix 25 / Fix 127 – runCollection scan_fn not called (lines 396–402): Replace _ = info; with a call to info.scan_fn(info.ptr, &ctx) (or however the scan callback is defined in GCObjectInfo). This traverses child pointers and adds them to the worklist.

Fix 26 / Fix 128 – runConcurrentMark scan_fn not called (lines 586–591): Same fix as above, inside the worker thread's run function: replace _ = info; with info.scan_fn(info.ptr, ctx.deques[ctx.worker_id]) (push children onto the local deque).

Fix 27 / Fix 126 – runCollection missing commitTransaction (lines 415–422): After try self.freeObjectGraph(&tx, ptr, 0);, add try self.wal.commitTransaction(&tx);. Also add defer self.wal.endTransaction(&tx) catch {}; after beginTransaction.

Fix 28 – freeObjectGraph no cycle detection (lines 275–297): Replace the depthlimitonly approach with a proper visited set. Pass a *std.AutoHashMap(u64, void) through the recursion. Before processing a node, check if its offset is already in the set; if so, skip it. Insert the offset before recursing into children.

Fix 29 – addReference discards parent_offset (lines 65–68): Remove _ = parent_offset;. Add a reference_graph: std.AutoHashMap(u64, std.ArrayList(u64)) field to GCContext. In addReference, append child_ptr.offset to the list keyed by parent_offset. This builds the reference graph for cycle detection.

Fix 97 – runCollection swallows getRoot error (lines 391–395): Change const root = self.heap.getRoot(); to const root = try self.heap.getRoot(); (if getRoot is fallible) so errors propagate instead of silently producing a null root.

Fix 120–125 – ObjectHeader offset calculations: In incrementRefCount (line 198), decrementRefCountLocked (line 231), freeObjectGraph (line 287), drainDeferredFrees (line 315), and flushBatchedRefCounts (line 492): the ObjectHeader is located at ptr.offset - oh_size, not at ptr.offset. Change all base_addr + ptr.offset (or base_addr + op.offset) casts to base_addr + ptr.offset - oh_size (respectively op.offset - oh_size).

Fix 125 – runVirtualCompaction ptr.offset assignment (lines 646–651): PersistentAllocator.free() expects the payload offset (after the header). Set ptr.offset to the payload offset (offset + oh_size), not the header offset.

Fix 129 – drainDeferredFrees missing commitTransaction (lines 318–328): After the free operations inside the loop, add try self.wal.commitTransaction(&tx);.



 src/dhtm.zig

Fix 30 – broadcastCommit/broadcastAbort direct function calls (lines 542–554): Replace p.commit(tx.tx_id) and p.abort(tx.tx_id) with calls through a network abstraction. Add a NetworkLayer interface (or use the existing WAL transport) with sendCommit(node_id, tx_id) and sendAbort(node_id, tx_id) methods. Wire it into DHTMCoordinator.

Fix 31 – twoPhaseCommit no timeout (lines 503–540): Wrap each p.prepare(tx) call with a deadline. Record std.time.nanoTimestamp() before the loop. After each prepare, check if nanoTimestamp() - start > DHTM_PREPARE_TIMEOUT_NS. If so, set all_prepared = false, set tx.abort_reason = .timeout, and break.

Fix 32 – begin mutex leak (lines 458–466): Add defer self.mutex.unlock(); immediately after self.mutex.lock(); (before try self.active_txs.put(...)). The current code calls unlock() manually only on the success path; an error from put leaks the lock.

Fix 98 – checkConflictSIMD misleading name: Rename to checkWriteWriteConflictSIMD. The existing readWriteConflict function already handles readwrite conflicts. Add a combined checkAllConflicts function that calls both and returns true if either finds a conflict.



 src/transaction.zig

Fix 33 / Fix 102 – Transaction.init undefined fields (lines 216–236): Initialize all undefined fields to valid empty values:
 operations: std.ArrayList(Operation).init(allocator_ptr)
 read_set: std.ArrayList(u64).init(allocator_ptr)
 write_set: std.ArrayList(u64).init(allocator_ptr)
 pending_allocations: std.ArrayList(u64).init(allocator_ptr)
 stm_write_log: std.ArrayList(STMWriteEntry).init(allocator_ptr)
 stm_read_log: std.ArrayList(STMReadEntry).init(allocator_ptr)
 allocator: allocator_ptr

Fix 34 / Fix 103 – htmCommitTx double lock deadlock (lines 863–878): The code acquires self.lock.lock() at line 864 (inside the if (tx.wal_tx) block) and again at line 872. std.Thread.RwLock is not reentrant. Remove the second self.lock.lock() / defer self.lock.unlock() pair at lines 872–873. Move the active_transactions.fetchRemove and heap.flush() calls inside the first lock scope, or restructure so the lock is held for the entire commit section.

Fix 76 / Fix 104 – retryableCommit swallows rollback error (lines 749–752): Change self.rollback(tx) catch {}; to:
zig
self.rollback(tx) catch |rb_err| {
    std.log.err("rollback failed after work_fn error: {}", .{rb_err});
};

Return the original work_err after logging.

Fix 105 – timeoutTransactions stops on first error (lines 726–736): Wrap try self.wal.rollbackTransaction(wal_tx) in a catch |err| { std.log.err(...); } so the loop continues processing remaining timedout transactions.

Fix 106 – stmCommitLocked partial commit (lines 516–519): Track how many writes have been applied. If self.heap.write(wentry.offset, wentry.data) fails, undo all previously applied writes by rereading the old data from the WAL undo log and writing it back.

Fix 107 – commit DHTM/WAL inconsistency (lines 569–577): If drt.commit(dhtm_tx) succeeds but self.wal.commitTransaction(wal_tx) fails, call drt.abort(dhtm_tx) (or a compensating transaction) before returning the error.



 src/wal.zig

Fix 35 / Fix 108 – getRedoData always returns error (lines 1183–1187): Implement redo data storage. Add a redo_data: std.AutoHashMap(u64, []u8) field to WAL (keyed by record sequence number). In appendRecord for .write type records, store a copy of the new data. In getRedoData, look up by record.sequence and return the stored slice.

Fix 36 – waitAsync busywait (lines 766–774): Replace the spinloop with a condition variable wait:
zig
self.writer_mutex.lock();
defer self.writer_mutex.unlock();
while (!entry.completed.load(.acquire)) {
    self.writer_cond.wait(&self.writer_mutex);
}

Signal the condition in drainAsyncQueueOnce after setting entry.completed.

Fix 37 – enqueueAsyncTransaction wrong pop on queuefull (lines 749–754): The errdefer _ = tx.records.pop() at line 736 fires if enqueue fails, but by that point tx.records has already been moved into entry.wal_tx. The pop would operate on the nowempty tx.records. Fix by saving the record count before the move and restoring tx.records from entry.wal_tx.records on the error path, then popping.

Fix 70 – drainAsyncQueueOnce completed flag set outside loop (lines 696–712): Move entry.completed.store(true, .release) inside the for (batch.items) loop, immediately after processing each entry, so a waiting thread is unblocked as soon as its entry is done rather than waiting for the entire batch.

Fix 71 / Fix 109 – beginTransaction transaction_counter not rolled back (lines 780–792): Wrap the body in an errdefer:
zig
errdefer self.header.transaction_counter = next_id - 1;

Place it before try tx.addRecord(begin_record) so that if addRecord fails, the counter is decremented.

Fix 94 – WAL sim mode guard (lines 530–536): Add assertions or explicit error returns to the prodpath functions when vfs.kind == .sim. For example, in any function that accesses vfs.prod_mapping, add std.debug.assert(self.vfs.kind == .prod) or return error.SimModeNotSupported.

Fix 99 – checkpoint record not in a transaction (lines 968–990): Wrap the checkpoint record write in a minimal transaction: call beginTransaction, append the checkpoint record, then commitTransaction. This ensures getTransactions can find and replay it.



 src/pheap.zig

Fix 38 / Fix 116 – markFreed empty body (lines 1399–1403): Implement the function: call self.freeListInsert(offset, size) and self.persistFreeListMetadata() to return the block to the free list. Also call self.markDirty(offset, size).

Fix 39 / Fix 112 – allocate duplicate fsync (lines 811–816): Remove the second try self.vfs.fsync(); at line 815. Keep only the one at line 813 (after syncRange).

Fix 40 / Fix 113 – bumpBlock duplicate fsync (lines 893–902): Remove the second try self.vfs.fsync(); at line 901. Keep only the one at line 895.

Fix 41 / Fix 114 – deallocate extra fsyncs (lines 953–968): Keep only one try self.vfs.fsync(); at the end. Remove the two intermediate calls at lines 955 and 964.

Fix 42 – HeapDirtyRecoveryRequired not handled in runtime (lines 558–562): In src/runtime.zig Runtime.init, catch error.HeapDirtyRecoveryRequired from PersistentHeap.init. On that error, initialize the RecoveryEngine first (without the heap), run recovery.recover(), then retry PersistentHeap.init.

Fix 43 – shrink sim backend buffer not truncated (lines 1538–1541): After self.vfs.sim.?.size = aligned;, also truncate the underlying buffer: self.vfs.sim.?.buf = self.vfs.sim.?.buf[0..aligned]; (or call a SimVfsBackend.truncate(aligned) method that reallocates).

Fix 95 – pheap sim mode guard (lines 479–486): Same pattern as Fix 94: add std.debug.assert(self.vfs.kind == .prod) or explicit error returns in all functions that access vfs.prod_base or vfs.prod_file.

Fix 115 – tryReuseLarge duplicate fsync (lines 857–862): Remove the second try self.vfs.fsync(); at line 861.



 src/recovery.zig

Fix 44 / Fix 110 – redoTransaction missing record types (lines 296–308): Add gc_mark, gc_sweep, ref_count_inc, ref_count_dec to the noop branch alongside .begin, .commit, .rollback, .checkpoint. These records do not need redo.

Fix 45 / Fix 111 – undoTransaction missing record types (lines 458–463): Add gc_mark, gc_sweep, ref_count_inc, ref_count_dec to the noop branch alongside .begin, .commit, .rollback, .checkpoint.

Fix 46 – redoRecord .write branch always fails (lines 343–351): This depends on Fix 35. Once getRedoData is implemented, this branch will work. No additional change needed here beyond Fix 35.

Fix 140 (partial) – finalizeRecovery duplicate sync (lines 562–569): Remove the first try self.heap.sync(); at line 562. Keep only the one at line 569 (after clearing the dirty flag).



 src/cloud/sandbox.zig

Fix 47 / Fix 48 – spawnTenantSandbox cgroup not set (lines 109–121): Change the clone_args initialization to:
zig
.flags = CLONE_NEWPID | CLONE_NEWNS | CLONE_NEWNET | CLONE_NEWIPC | CLONE_NEWUTS | CLONE_NEWUSER | CLONE_INTO_CGROUP,
.cgroup = @intCast(cgroup_fd),

This places the child process directly into the cgroup at spawn time.



 src/cloud/sandbox_runner.zig

Fix 13 – RDMA channel connects to /dev/null (lines 305–334): Remove the entire rdma_blk block that opens /dev/null and calls ch.setRemoteEndpoint(ch.localEndpoint()). The RDMA channel should only be initialized when a real remote endpoint is available. Add a check: only set up the RDMA shipper if a real peer address is provided via an environment variable (e.g., AGDB_RDMA_PEER).

Fix 72 – gpa_state.deinit() bypassed by exit(0) (lines 368–371): Replace std.os.linux.exit(0) with return (or break out of the loop). Let the normal function return path run all defers, including gpa_state.deinit().

Fix 73 – db.close() only on ConnectionClosed (lines 367–372): Move db.close() to a defer at the top of the function (after db is initialized) so it is called on all exit paths.

Fix 79 – Inconsistent syscall whitelists: Extract allowed_syscalls from sandbox_runner.zig into a shared file (e.g., src/cloud/seccomp_policy.zig). Import it in both sandbox_runner.zig and process_table.zig (wherever SECCOMP_ALLOWED_SYSCALLS is defined). Delete the duplicate definition.

Fix 80 – Hardcoded AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64 (line 22): Replace the magic constant 3221225534 with a compiletime expression:
zig
const AUDIT_ARCH_X86_64: u32 = 0xC000003E;

Wrap the seccomp filter generation in a comptime architecture check: if (builtin.cpu.arch != .x86_64) @compileError("seccomp filter only supports x86_64"); or generate the correct AUDIT_ARCH_* constant for the target architecture.



 src/cloud/process_table.zig

Fix 49 / Fix 137 – failPendingForTenant ignores tenant_id (lines 432–446): Remove _ = tenant_id;. Add a filter: only fail requests where entry.key_ptr.* matches the tenant. Since pending_requests is keyed by request_id, add a tenant_id field to WaitingRequest and check wr.tenant_id == tenant_id.

Fix 50 / Fix 138 – stopAllSupervisors double lock (lines 290–304): Remove the second self.supervisors_mu.lock() at line 297. The first lock is held from line 291 to line 295 (unlock). The second lock at line 297 reacquires it. Instead, hold the lock for the entire function:
zig
self.supervisors_mu.lock();
defer self.supervisors_mu.unlock();
for (self.supervisors.items) |*sv| sv.shutdown.store(true, .release);
for (self.supervisors.items) |*sv| { sv.thread.join(); self.allocator.destroy(sv.shutdown); }
self.supervisors.clearRetainingCapacity();


Fix 139 – insertWithSeccomp mutex leak (lines 381–387): Add defer self.mu.unlock(); immediately after self.mu.lock();. Remove the manual self.mu.unlock() at line 384.

Fix 140 (partial) – reapZombies lock ordering (lines 457–476): reapZombies calls self.failPendingForTenant(tid) while holding self.mu. failPendingForTenant acquires self.pending_mutex. Ensure all other call sites that hold both locks acquire them in the same order (mu first, then pending_mutex). Audit runDispatchLoop and fix any inversions.

Fix 140 (partial) – runDispatchLoop no restart on error (lines 518–521): Wrap the return error.EpollWaitFailed in a log + continue so the loop restarts on nonEINTR errors instead of permanently dying.



 src/cloud/registry.zig

Fix 61 – registerTenant nonatomic tenant_list update (lines 154–170): Wrap the tenant_list readmodifywrite in the same KV transaction as the tenant record write. If the KV store supports transactions, use one. Otherwise, write the tenant record and the updated list in a single put batch, or use a WAL record to make the operation idempotent on replay.

Fix 117 – storeApiKeyHash nonatomic hash + key update (lines 204–211): Perform both kv.put(tenant_key, ...) and kv.put(apikey_key, ...) inside a single KV transaction (or use a WALbacked atomic write) so a crash between the two does not leave the tenant record with a new hash but no corresponding lookup entry.

Fix 118 – deleteKV swallows error (lines 318–322): Change _ = self.db.kv.delete(kv_key) catch false; to try self.db.kv.delete(kv_key); and propagate the error to the caller.

Fix 119 – revokeTenant nonatomic active flag + key deletion (lines 264–271): Perform the API key deletion and record.active = 0 write atomically. Write both changes in a single KV transaction or use a WAL record so a crash cannot leave the tenant active with a deleted API key.



 src/kv.zig

Fix 62 – replayLog silently breaks on CRC error (lines 365–367): Replace break; with return error.CRCMismatch; so the caller knows data loss occurred and can decide whether to truncate or abort.

Fix 63 – No automatic compaction trigger: After each put that increments self.dead_bytes, check if (self.dead_bytes > self.file_size / 2) try self.compact(); (or a configurable threshold). This prevents unbounded log growth.

Fix 85 – corrupt_on_write fault handler does nothing (lines 436–440): After self.io.sim.fault.armed = false;, actually corrupt the write: flip a byte in the data before writing, e.g., data[0] ^= 0xFF;.



 src/security.zig (additional)

Already covered in Fixes 17–19, 64, 65 above.



 src/concurrency.zig

Fix 66 – Fixed 4096element guard_registry_entries (lines 35–36): Replace the fixed array with a std.ArrayList(GuardEntry) protected by guard_registry_mutex. Initialize it lazily. This removes the hard cap on concurrent guards.



 src/allocator.zig

Fix 67 – allocateFromSizeClass no validation of node.next (lines 378–384): Before using node.next as the new head_offset, validate it: check that it is either 0 or within [HEADER_SIZE, heap_size). If invalid, log an error and return error.FreeListCorrupt.

Fix 68 – undoAllocation flushes wrong range (lines 218–219): Change try self.heap.flushRange(offset + @sizeOf(header.ObjectHeader)); to try self.heap.flushRange(offset, @sizeOf(header.ObjectHeader)); (flush only the header, not from the header to the end of the heap).

Fix 96 – resizeImpl/remapImpl always return false/null (lines 603–619): Implement inplace resize: check if the block immediately following the current allocation is free and large enough. If so, merge it and update the object header size. Return true/the same pointer on success, false/null otherwise.



 src/cloud/ipc.zig

Fix 100 – IpcHeader not extern struct (lines 6–12): Change pub const IpcHeader = struct { to pub const IpcHeader = extern struct {. This guarantees a stable, Ccompatible memory layout for direct @ptrCast usage.



 src/cloud/router.zig

Fix 60 – Perrequest 16 MB allocation (lines 75–76): Add a response_buf_pool: std.ArrayList([]u8) to Router. On each request, pop a buffer from the pool (or allocate if empty). After the request, push it back. Cap the pool size at e.g. 32 buffers to bound memory usage.



 src/cloud/registration.zig

Fix 83 – Hardcoded buf[pos + 16..] offset (lines 99–101): Replace buf[pos + 16..][0..2] with a proper struct field access. Define const linux_dirent64 = extern struct { d_ino: u64, d_off: i64, d_reclen: u16, d_type: u8, d_name: [256]u8 }; and cast &buf[pos] to *const linux_dirent64. Use .d_reclen instead of the hardcoded offset.

 A kérés miért nem hajtható végre így

Miért nem lehet "mindet egyszerre" megcsinálni

Minden egyes módosítás elvégzéséhez el kell olvasnom az adott fájl teljes tartalmát, meg kell találnom a pontos sorokat, el kell készítenem a javított verziót, majd be kell küldenem az új SHAval együtt.
